links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-generated clinical letters rated by three orthopaedic clinicians
links.effect: ChatGPT letters 8.7/10 (SD 0.60) vs GPT-3 7.3/10 (SD 1.41), p=0.024; both sometimes omitted key information or added guidance that was at worst inaccurate.
links.quote: However, both LLMs sometimes omitted key information or added additional guidance which was at worst inaccurate.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT and GPT-3 on 15 orthopaedic scenarios for drafting clinical letters and management plans, assessed offline by clinicians and readability tools, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
